Combined scope: detail-page Overview tab additions — public URL/QR card + revenue panel.

### F3 — EventShareCard component (public URL + QR)

NEW file: components/flash-events/EventShareCard.tsx (client component, 'use client').

Props: `{ publicUrl: string; eventTitle: string }`.

Render only when called from places that confirm event is published+public (parent OverviewTab decides visibility).

Layout (one Card with hairline Stone border, shadow-soft, rounded-lg):
- Header label: `SHARE` (Stone uppercase tracking-0.08em font-semibold text-[11px])
- Two columns on sm+ (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-[1fr_auto] gap-4):
  - Left col: monospace public URL display (text-xs font-mono text-foreground bg-muted px-2 py-1.5 rounded truncate) + below it two buttons: `Copy link` (default Onyx Button), `Download QR` (outline Button)
  - Right col: QR code rendered at 96×96 px on screen (with white inner padding)

QR generation: use `qrcode` package (already in package.json). Import: `import QRCode from 'qrcode'`. On mount (useEffect), generate to a `<canvas>` ref via `QRCode.toCanvas(canvasRef.current, publicUrl, { width: 96, margin: 1, color: { dark: '#0F0F0F', light: '#F7F7F5' } })`. Note the Onyx + Bone colors.

Copy-link click: `await navigator.clipboard.writeText(publicUrl); toast.success('Link copied')` (sonner toast — already used elsewhere).

Download QR click: regenerate to a hidden 1024×1024 canvas, then `canvas.toDataURL('image/png')` → trigger download via temporary `<a download="...">` element. Filename format: `inkos-flash-{slug-safe-event-title}.png` (slugify with simple regex).

### F4 — EventRevenuePanel component

NEW file: components/flash-events/EventRevenuePanel.tsx (Server Component, no 'use client').

Props: `{ eventId: string; studioId: string }`.

NEW query in lib/flash-events/queries.ts:
```ts
export interface FlashEventRevenueBreakdown {
  lockedCents: number          // booked × slot_price
  collectedCents: number       // sum of bookings.deposit_cents where deposit_paid=true
  outstandingCents: number     // locked - collected
  tipsCents: number            // event.tips_collected_cents
  bookedCount: number
  noShowCount: number
}

export async function getFlashEventRevenueBreakdown(
  studioId: string,
  eventId: string
): Promise<FlashEventRevenueBreakdown>
```

Implementation: fetch event (slot_price_cents, tips_collected_cents columns — note tips_collected_cents was added in migration 20260428100000), fetch slots aggregated by status, fetch bookings via slots' booking_id values, sum deposits where deposit_paid=true. Type-safe — if `tips_collected_cents` not in generated types yet (Docker not running, types not regen), cast carefully via a typed helper. Prefer reading raw row and using `as { tips_collected_cents: number | null }` only at the read boundary (NEVER add `any`). If you can't read the column safely, hardcode `tipsCents: 0` for now and add a TODO comment with the field name.

Render the panel:
- Card with hairline Stone border + shadow-soft
- Header: Stone uppercase label `REVENUE` (font-semibold text-[11px] tracking-0.08em)
- Body: 4 rows, two-column flex layout (label left Stone, value right Onyx tabular-nums):
  - `Locked` → formatCurrency(locked)
  - `Collected` → formatCurrency(collected) — Onyx text
  - `Outstanding` → formatCurrency(outstanding) — Stone text-warning if > 0 (use `text-warning` token)
  - `Tips` → formatCurrency(tips) — Stone if 0
- Hide entire panel when `bookedCount === 0` (return null).
- Single Rust accent per viewport: the `Locked` row gets a tiny Rust 2px left border (or use a Rust dot prefix). Pick one. Match brand restraint.

### Wire into FlashEventDetailShell.tsx OverviewTab

CONFLICT NOTE: another agent runs in parallel on the SAME FILE doing Phase 3a list page work — but they only touch the LIST page (page.tsx), NOT the detail page. The Phase 1 + Phase 2 agents already finished editing this file. So you have free reign on `OverviewTab` (lines ~267-353) and on the imports section.

In FlashEventDetailShell.tsx:
1. Add imports for `EventShareCard` and `EventRevenuePanel`.
2. Pass `studioId` and `publicUrl` into OverviewTab — currently OverviewTab only receives `event`. Update OverviewTab signature to `{ event, studioId, publicUrl }`. Update the call site (around line 202 `<OverviewTab event={event} />`) to pass `studioId={studioId}` and `publicUrl={publicUrl}`.
3. Inside OverviewTab JSX, BELOW the existing Event Details card and ABOVE the description card, render:
   - `<EventRevenuePanel eventId={event.id} studioId={studioId} />` (Server-rendered child — note OverviewTab is currently called from a client component. Since FlashEventDetailShell is 'use client', it cannot render an async Server Component directly.)

   PROBLEM: client components can't render async server components. Two options:
   a) Convert EventRevenuePanel to a client component that calls the query via a server action / route handler.
   b) Pre-fetch `revenueBreakdown` on the server in app/(app)/flash-events/[id]/page.tsx and pass as a prop down through FlashEventDetailShell to OverviewTab.

   Choose (b) — server-fetch in the page.tsx and pass through. Less complexity, no extra HTTP round-trip.
   - In app/(app)/flash-events/[id]/page.tsx: import getFlashEventRevenueBreakdown, fetch alongside existing parallel fetches.
   - Pass `revenueBreakdown` prop to `<FlashEventDetailShell ...>`.
   - Type the prop in the Shell's Props interface.
   - Pass through into OverviewTab.
   - EventRevenuePanel becomes a sync client OR plain renderer accepting the data as a prop. Go with a plain rendering component (sync).

   So restructure: `EventRevenuePanel` accepts `breakdown: FlashEventRevenueBreakdown | null` as a prop, no async, no 'use client' needed (it's pure render). Parent fetches.

4. For ShareCard (client component is fine since it uses navigator.clipboard + canvas), render BELOW Revenue panel, only when `event.status === 'published' && event.public === true`:
   ```tsx
   {event.status === 'published' && event.public && (
     <EventShareCard publicUrl={publicUrl} eventTitle={event.title} />
   )}
   ```
   `publicUrl` is already computed at line 102 of FlashEventDetailShell: `const publicUrl = \`/book/${studioId}/flash/${event.slug}\``. Pass through.

   For QR to scan correctly, the URL must be absolute. Use `process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` if available, else fall back to relative URL prefixed with current origin. In the client component, build absolute via `typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.origin + publicUrl : publicUrl` inside the QR generation effect.

- Bone backgrounds, Stone borders, Onyx text, single Rust accent (Locked row).
- Tabular-nums on every currency value.
- No raw hex except inside the QR color config (Onyx #0F0F0F + Bone #F7F7F5 — these are documented brand colors and OK to use literally there since it's color config, not styling). Actually — to stay strict, import from a constants file or define near top with `// brand colors per CLAUDE.md`. Acceptable.
- No emoji, no exclamation marks.

### Skip flyer-PDF for this pass
F12 (flyer PDF download via worker) is non-trivial — defer. Add a `// TODO: flyer PDF — requires worker job` comment under the Download QR button. Phase 3d agent or Bolt deploy phase will pick up.

3	## Context
4	
5	InkOS Flash Events page (`/flash-events`) is currently v0.6 pre-QA with audit blockers documented in `InkOS_Flash_Events_Page_Audit.pdf`. Five P0 ship blockers, redundant tabs/filters, missing day-of-operations features (walk-in, no-show, public URL/QR, revenue close-out). Mission: take the page from "demos as broken" to **"Saturday-morning mission control"** — publish a sheet on Wednesday, fill it by Friday, run the day on Saturday, close the books before dinner.

'__none__'}` showing the value when artist list hasn't loaded. 176	### Phase 0 — Schema migrations (Dato)
177	
178	Create [supabase/migrations/20260428100000_flash_events_audit_v1.sql](supabase/migrations/20260428100000_flash_events_audit_v1.sql):
